title: Little Hawley Rising Anew
author: Xanthe Blackwood
blurb: Kestrel Thornbury, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
